origin.self_selected_from: REC-39 / CF-31 open critical-path item: the controller hash scan reports 4 full accepts at F2b b2ab6acb2bbe while the formulation lead per-file census reports 0 accept / 7 revise; astra-life05-verify-gform-r3 (lead-audit, 02:45) must publish a per-file binding table. A successor worker census landed at 01:19:32 (worker-018, w018-f2bcov-20260912T011927+0800-claim).

blindness_disclosure.why: Orientation required reading comms/PROTOCOL.md, research_map/ASTRA_HANDOFF.md, the gate records and the accepted event stream, so the controller 4-accept / lead 0-accept divergence and worker-018's 01:19:32 census statement were seen before this preregistration. This is therefore an adversarial independent replication with a different method (immutable event-stream first, disk second), not a blind review. The falsifiers below can still refute worker-018's stated count.
blindness_disclosure.method_independence: This instrument does not read, import, or execute artifacts/worker-018/f2b_coverage_census/*. It re-derives the count from research_map/events.jsonl and live bytes only.

method.M1_live_pins: sha256 the four pin files plus the three artifacts/formulation/schemas mirrors; fail closed if any live prefix differs from the declared prefix or any mirror pair is not byte-equal.
method.M2_immutable_ledger: Parse research_map/events.jsonl (append-only accepted stream). Keep event_type=review events whose explicit reviewed_sha256 field equals the live F2b pin, or whose target_id carries the live F2b prefix while reviewed_sha256 is absent. Events that cite the pin only in evidence_refs are recorded separately as pin_citing_only and never counted.
M3_scope_rules: R1 explicit_full_schema: counts_as_full_schema_verdict is present and true.

R2 pin_bound_schema_level (primary): reviewed_sha256 == live F2b pin AND the target_id does not carry a candidate/aspect-scope token from the fixed list [candidate, staged, rev30, coverage, accept-coverage, vocab, containment-rebase, normativity, repair-acceptance, HF-, '#']. This is the pre-registered primary count.
R3 all_pin_bound: every event with reviewed_sha256 == live F2b pin, scope tokens ignored.
method.M4_supersession: An event is superseded when a later (created_at) event by the same reviewer references it, matched by supersedes_path == its review_path, or supersedes_sha256 == its review_sha256, or supersedes == its event_id. Also reported: latest_per_reviewer (keep newest event per reviewer) and raw (no supersession).
method.M5_field_key_effect: Repeat the accept count while binding only on the field name artifact_sha256 (the field key used by the controller hash scan hypothesis) and report the delta against reviewed_sha256 binding.
method.M6_disk_quiescence_and_mutation: For every review event that declares an explicit (path, sha256) pair in review_path/review_sha256, review_file/review_file_sha256, verdict_file/verdict_file_sha256, or supersedes_path/supersedes_sha256, re-hash the file on disk and classify match/mismatch/missing. A mismatch is a measured post-ingest mutation or a bad declaration; the instrument reports which, without adjudicating intent.
method.M7_determinism: All lists sorted canonically; core_digest = sha256 of the canonical JSON of {pins, counts, supersession, mutation, field_key} with timestamps excluded. Two consecutive runs must produce the same core_digest.

pre_registered_expectations: E1: live F2b == b2ab6acb2bbe..., F1 == d9cebb9404b2..., F2a == e9a27996dfd3..., FROZEN == 815e08079aef..., and all three canonical/mirror pairs byte-equal.
E2: the R2 supersession-adjusted full-schema accept set is exactly {worker-052, worker-071, worker-090} (three accepts).

E3: the raw R3 pin-bound accept count is four; the fourth is worker-072's 01:10:13 accept, superseded by worker-072's 01:15:24 revise whose supersedes_path is reviews/F2b-review-worker-072-rev29.json and whose supersedes_sha256 is 7487f310d208...; therefore the controller's 4th accept is stale at the measurement instant.
E4: an artifact_sha256-field-keyed census returns zero accepts at the pin, i.e. worker-018's field-key effect and the lead's 0-accept count are reproducible as a field-name artifact.
E5: worker-018's decisive count (3 live full-schema accepts, worker-072 superseded, artifact_sha256-keyed 0) is reproduced by this independent event-stream method.
E6: no explicit declared review-file hash mismatches the live file at measurement time, or every mismatch is enumerated with path, declared hash, measured hash and mtime.
controls: C1 live-pin identity and mirror equality (fail closed, exit 2 on any drift).
C2 synthetic supersession chain: an accept at t1 followed by a revise at t2 that references it must drop the accept from the supersession-adjusted set.
C3 synthetic field-key case: an event with artifact_sha256 == pin and no reviewed_sha256 must be excluded by the reviewed_sha256 binding and exposed by the artifact_sha256 binding.
C4 synthetic mutation: a declared (path, sha256) pair with a wrong hash must be classified mismatch.
C5 duplicate event_id must be counted once.
C6 an event bound to a superseded pin (1bb78ce9b357) must not enter the live count.
C7 scope filter: a pin-bound event whose target_id carries a candidate/aspect token must be excluded from R2 and retained in R3.
falsifiers: F1 any live pin or mirror differs from its declared value at run time (claim void, not a falsification of worker-018).

F2 a fourth live R2 full-schema accept bound to b2ab6acb2bbe exists that is not worker-072's superseded accept; or one of the three named accepts is not a live accept, is not bound to the pin, or is candidate/aspect-scoped.
F3 worker-072's 01:15:24 revise does not actually supersede its 01:10:13 accept (wrong supersedes_path/sha), so the 4-accept raw count cannot be dismissed as stale.
F4 an artifact_sha256-field-keyed binding returns a nonzero accept count at the pin.
F5 any mismatch between an explicitly declared review-file hash and the live file that the instrument fails to report.
F6 two consecutive runs of the instrument produce different core_digest values.
stop_rule: Bounded to this one replication. Stop and report if (a) any live pin or mirror has moved, (b) research_map/events.jsonl is not parseable as one JSON object per line, or (c) the claim would require adjudicating verdict merit, node status, validation_status or a gate verdict. No canonical path is written.
non_claims: Not a G-FORM gate verdict and not a node status; worker events cannot set status=done, validation_status=passed or a gate verdict.
Does not re-adjudicate whether the three accepts are correct, only that they are the live pin-bound supersession-adjusted accept records.
Does not adjudicate the formulation lead's census method beyond the measured field-key effect.
Does not edit schemas, FROZEN.json, review files, ledger, detector or the research map.
